This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. 

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

This position works as a member of Bain’s internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Technical Delivery (50%)**

* Lead  a scrum team developing and updating applications
* Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration.

* Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog.

* Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped.

  

**Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)**

* Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc.
* Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk.
* Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.
* Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc.
* Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems.
* Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication, time management and customer service skills.
* High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience.

  

**Data Engineering - Technical skills:**

* Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala
* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob       Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory

Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.

Frontend and Data Visualization

* Write and maintain database queries, schema migrations, and data access logic for Artemis data models. Optimize for the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.

Quality and Collaboration

* Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go-to-market-aligned specialists to understand how tools are being used in live engagements, and translate that feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
* Strong interpersonal skills, able to work across all levels of the organization.

  s.

* Strong CSS skills and experience working with component libraries and design systems.

title: Implementation Business Analyst (Customer Delivery & Business Solution)
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery – shaping the lens of “only Amplify Health can do”.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Role Overview**

The Implementation Business Analyst is a customer-facing member of the Implementation Team, responsible for turning customer business needs into clear, implementable requirements and coordinating those requirements through solution design, product alignment, testing, and go-live. The role is based in India and reports to the Implementation Lead in Singapore.

The role focuses on business analysis and implementation ownership rather than acting as the primary configuration specialist. It requires strong healthcare claims knowledge, structured documentation, confident customer facilitation, and the ability to connect business, clinical, product, engineering, integration, and QA teams to drive decisions and delivery.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Business Requirements, Workshops & Solution Definition**

* Lead and facilitate customer workshops to understand current-state claims, benefits, pre-authorisation and operational processes, and translate them into clear future-state requirements.
* Capture and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, decision logs, assumptions and sign-off records.
* Prepare or contribute to implementation artefacts such as functional specifications, requirements frameworks, mapping workbooks, implementation plans and customer-facing summaries.
* Challenge unclear or incomplete requirements, separate confirmed scope from open questions, and drive closure with the relevant business and product stakeholders.

**2) Claims, Benefits and Business Rules Analysis**

* Analyse claims-calculation scenarios, benefit-triggering logic, exclusions, limits, tariffs, professional fees, utilisation and pre-authorisation requirements.
* Work with customer subject-matter experts to document formulas, decision rules, exceptions and expected outcomes in a form that product, engineering and QA teams can implement and test.
* Assess whether requirements can be met through standard product capability, configuration, an operational workaround or a product enhancement, and clearly document the recommended path and dependencies.
* Partner with configuration specialists and clinical SMEs to ensure requirements are sufficiently clear for benefit, rule, tariff and clinical-set configuration.

**3) Integration and Data Requirements**

* Coordinate business and functional analysis for API and data integration, including REST/JSON and HL7/FHIR-based claim request and response structures.
* Clarify field definitions, ownership, source-system availability, validation rules and mapping assumptions with customer and internal integration teams.
* Prepare sample payloads, field lists and mapping documentation, and coordinate internal review before customer submission and sign-off.
* Track integration dependencies and product gaps, and support defect analysis and retesting with engineering and QA teams.

**4) Delivery Tracking, Scope and Dependency Management**

* Maintain implementation trackers covering deliverables, decisions, actions, dependencies, risks, blockers, target dates and sign-off status.
* Create and maintain Jira epics and stories for implementation items, ensuring that requirements, acceptance criteria, ownership and dependencies are clearly recorded.
* Monitor customer and internal dependencies, highlight missed inputs or decisions early, and provide concise status updates and escalation points to the Implementation Lead.
* Support implementation planning by sequencing activities, identifying prerequisites and coordinating work across product, engineering, QA, clinical, configuration and customer teams.
* Apply disciplined scope and change control by identifying new or changed requirements, assessing delivery impact and ensuring agreement before implementation.

**5) Testing, Readiness and Go-Live Support**

* Define business acceptance criteria and expected results for functional, SIT and UAT scenarios, with particular focus on end-to-end claims outcomes.
* Support QA and customer testers by clarifying requirements, reproducing functional issues, distinguishing defects from requirement gaps, and coordinating resolution and retesting.
* Validate that agreed requirements, configurations, integrations and operational dependencies are ready for release and customer sign-off.
* Support cutover, go-live and post-release triage by preparing readiness inputs, tracking open items and coordinating business validation.

**6) Customer Enablement and Stakeholder Communication**

* Act as a day-to-day functional point of contact for assigned implementation workstreams and communicate clearly with customer business and technology stakeholders.
* Prepare structured meeting agendas, minutes, decision summaries, action lists and follow-up communications that make ownership and next steps explicit.
* Deliver product and process enablement sessions covering claims concepts, benefit and rule configuration, clinical/reference data and implementation ways of working.
* Build effective working relationships across countries and time zones, while maintaining clear accountability between Amplify Health and customer teams.

**7) Continuous Improvement and Reuse**

* Capture lessons learned and convert implementation experience into reusable templates, frameworks, checklists, sample artefacts and delivery standards.
* Identify recurring product or process gaps and provide evidence-based recommendations to improve implementation efficiency, customer readiness and product usability.
* Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new implementation team members and business analysts.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of business analysis or customer implementation experience, preferably within health insurance, healthcare technology, insurance platforms or another regulated industry.
* Practical experience leading requirements workshops and producing user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional specifications, mapping documents and implementation trackers.
* Strong understanding of health-insurance claims and benefit concepts, including claim adjudication, exclusions, limits, utilisation, tariffs, professional fees and pre-authorisation.
* Experience working across customer, product, engineering, integration, QA, clinical and operations teams to resolve requirements and delivery dependencies.
* Working knowledge of REST/JSON APIs and data mapping; familiarity with HL7/FHIR claim structures is an advantage.
* Experience with Jira and Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, defect triage and change control.
* Experience facilitating customer training, requirements playback and sign-off discussions.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to facilitate regional customer discussions and produce concise, decision-oriented documentation.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently while reporting to a regional lead.
* Clinical coding knowledge, including ICD, CPT, diagnosis, procedure or pharmacy coding concepts, is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively from India with stakeholders and a reporting line based in Singapore; occasional regional travel may be required.

**What You Will Gain in This Role**

* Direct ownership of business-analysis deliverables across complex customer implementations, from discovery through go-live.
* Exposure to regional healthcare claims transformation, including benefits, rules, tariffs, clinical coding, APIs and FHIR-based integrations.
* Opportunity to shape reusable implementation methods and work closely with senior product, engineering, clinical, QA and customer stakeholders across Asia.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our platform includes

This is a high-ownership role. We need someone who can think independently, challenge assumptions when necessary, identify gaps before development begins, conduct strong R&D, and bring 
**original and innovative ideas**

• Apply strong 
**Business Analysis thinking**
 to understand and define user roles, permissions, business rules, workflows, dependencies, integrations, edge cases, exception scenarios, and different user journeys.

• Translate high-level ideas and requirements into structured 
**user journeys, process flows, information architecture, workflow diagrams, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and polished high-fidelity UI designs.**

**complex B2B SaaS, multi-tenant, and role-based platforms**
, considering how different organizations, administrators, teams, end users, partners, and other user types interact with the system.

• Conduct 
**R&D, competitor analysis, UX benchmarking, industry research, and product research**
 to identify best practices, emerging trends, gaps, and opportunities for innovation.

• Proactively bring 
**new ideas and original solutions**
 and recommend improvements to product workflows, usability, engagement, efficiency, accessibility, and overall user experience.

• Conduct 
**user research and user testing**
, including usability testing of wireframes, prototypes, and developed features with appropriate users.

• Develop appropriate testing scenarios and tasks, observe how users interact with the product, identify usability problems and points of confusion, gather and analyze feedback, document findings, and improve designs based on evidence.

• Validate important assumptions and workflows through testing rather than relying only on internal opinions or design assumptions.

• Iterate wireframes, prototypes, workflows, and final designs based on user feedback, testing results, business requirements, technical constraints, and product objectives.

• Design experiences that consider 
**current and future AI capabilities**
, including AI assistants, automation, intelligent recommendations, AI-supported decision-making, document intelligence, and intelligent workflows.

• Create clear, detailed design specifications and documentation for development teams and collaborate closely with developers throughout implementation.

• Ensure developers have sufficient information to accurately implement workflows, interactions, states, responsive behaviour, validations, and design requirements.

• Review developed features against approved designs and requirements for 
**design accuracy, functionality, usability, responsiveness, accessibility, missing states, workflow issues, inconsistencies, and overall UI/UX quality.**

• Perform 
**UI/UX QA and product testing**
 before features are considered complete, clearly document issues, communicate them to the development team, and verify corrections.

• Test complete user journeys across different roles and scenarios rather than reviewing only individual screens.

• Build and maintain scalable 
**design systems, reusable components, design patterns, and component libraries**
 for web and mobile applications.

• Maintain consistency across different modules, user roles, platforms, screen sizes, and product experiences.

• Create professional 
**graphic design assets**
 when required, including flyers, website graphics, banners, product visuals, presentation materials, and other digital marketing assets.

• Work collaboratively with product, business, technical, and development teams while taking strong individual ownership of assigned work.

**Requirements**

• 
**6+ years of professional UI/UX or Product Design experience**
, or an exceptional portfolio demonstrating equivalent capability.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality UI/UX work across complex web and mobile products.

• Advanced proficiency in 
**Figma**
 and modern design, wireframing, and prototyping tools.

• Strong understanding of 
**UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, responsive design, usability, accessibility, and user-centred design.**

• Strong hands-on experience with 
**user research, usability testing, user testing, gathering feedback, analyzing findings, and translating findings into meaningful design improvements.**

• Ability to plan and execute usability testing across wireframes, prototypes, and developed products.

• Strong 
**Business Analysis and product thinking skills**
, with the ability to turn complex or ambiguous ideas into structured, practical, execution-ready product solutions.

• Ability to understand and document 
**user roles, permissions, business rules, workflows, dependencies, happy paths, edge cases, exception scenarios, and end-to-end user journeys.**

• Experience designing 
**B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms is required.**

• Experience working with 
**multi-tenant platforms, role-based access control (RBAC), multiple user types, dashboards, permissions, complex workflows, and interconnected product modules**
 is strongly preferred.

• Experience designing complex platforms where different users see different functionality, permissions, workflows, and experiences based on their roles or status.

• Strong analytical, research, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong ability to conduct 
**independent R&D, competitor research, UX benchmarking, and product analysis**
 and translate research into practical product improvements.

• A self-starter with a high level of 
**ownership, creativity, curiosity, innovation, and initiative.**
 You should be comfortable thinking independently and moving work forward without requiring detailed direction at every step.

• Ability to bring original ideas and solutions rather than simply reproducing existing designs or waiting for detailed instructions.

• Excellent visual design skills with a strong sense of 
**colour and colour combinations, typography, spacing, hierarchy, layout, visual consistency, and modern design standards.**

• Excellent English communication and writing skills, including the ability to communicate requirements, design decisions, research findings, and testing observations clearly.

• Experience working closely with developers and understanding front-end implementation constraints.

**UI/UX quality assurance and product testing**
, including the ability to review implemented features against designs, requirements, workflows, and expected user behaviour.

• Strong graphic design skills, including the ability to create professional 
**flyers, website graphics, banners, presentation materials, and digital marketing assets.**

• Awareness and understanding of emerging 
**AI technologies and AI-driven user experiences.**

• Ability to think about how AI, automation, intelligent recommendations, and AI assistants can improve workflows and user experiences rather than treating AI simply as another interface element.

• 
**Experience in EdTech is preferred.**
 Experience with complex education technology platforms involving areas such as recruitment, admissions, verification, visa-related workflows, student engagement, or connected student lifecycle experiences would be an advantage.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can take a product idea from an initial conversation through the complete product design, validation, and implementation process:

title: Website Designer (Contract)
description:
**Full-time freelance · 6 weeks**

We are looking for someone who designs websites that work as businesses, not just as pages. That means understanding what a company sells, who buys it, and what that buyer needs to see, feel and believe before they act. The technical craft matters, but it serves that.

What you'll own

* **Understanding the business before designing for it.**
  What it sells, how it makes money, who the buyers are, what worries them, and what earns their trust. Every design decision you make should trace back to this.
* **Designing for the buyer's psychology.**
  A procurement head evaluating a B2B vendor needs proof, credibility and reassurance. A consumer comparing options on their phone needs clarity, speed and desire. You will know which job each page is doing, and design accordingly.
* **Information architecture and conversion paths.**
  Structure, navigation and content hierarchy that move a visitor from first impression to the action that matters, whether that is a demo request, an enquiry or a purchase.
* **The visual design system.**
  Typography, colour, components and responsive layouts that hold together across every page, not just the homepage.
* **Designing for findability, speed and maintainability.**
  SEO-friendly page structure, CDN-aware asset delivery, and CMS templates that non-designers can edit without breaking the layout.
* **A handoff that survives you.**
  Documented components and usage notes, so the site stays coherent after the contract ends.

What we're looking for

* **Websites that worked commercially.**
  Send us live links, each with a sentence on the business problem it solved and what changed after launch. We weigh the thinking behind the work as heavily as how it looks.
* **Range across B2B and B2C.**
  You can explain how designing for a considered, committee-driven B2B purchase differs from an emotional or impulse-led B2C decision, and show work that reflects both.
* **A strong grasp of persuasion and trust.**
  Visual hierarchy, message placement, social proof, objection handling and calls to action. Design as an argument, not decoration.
* **Domain curiosity.**
  The ability to learn an unfamiliar industry fast enough to design credibly for its customers within the first week.
* **Mobile-first responsive craft,**
  with accessibility basics treated as defaults rather than afterthoughts.
* **Working technical fluency.**
  How a CMS content model shapes design, SEO at the structural level, and CDN and performance fundamentals, including how to read a Lighthouse report.
* **Copywriting instinct.**
  You design words and layout together rather than leaving boxes for copy to fill later.

Signals that would move you to the top of the list

* **Conversion results you can point to.**
  A/B tests run, conversion rates improved, with numbers.
* **AI-assisted design workflows.**
  Hands-on use of tools like Claude Design to explore directions quickly. We care about your judgement in what you keep.
* **You can build what you design.**
  HTML and CSS, a CMS theme, or a production Webflow or Framer build. On a six-week timeline, a designer who can ship removes an entire handoff.
* **Site migrations and analytics.**
  Launching without losing search rankings, and planning tracking into the design rather than bolting it on.

What this role is not

It is not a visual-polish job where someone else decides what the site needs to say, and it is not a mockup-only engagement where someone else works out whether the design can be built. It is six weeks, full time, with a launch-ready website at the end.

description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery – shaping the lens of “only Amplify Health can do”.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Role Overview**

The Implementation Business Analyst is a customer-facing member of the Implementation Team, responsible for turning customer business needs into clear, implementable requirements and coordinating those requirements through solution design, product alignment, testing, and go-live. The role is based in India and reports to the Implementation Lead in Singapore.

The role focuses on business analysis and implementation ownership rather than acting as the primary configuration specialist. It requires strong healthcare claims knowledge, structured documentation, confident customer facilitation, and the ability to connect business, clinical, product, engineering, integration, and QA teams to drive decisions and delivery.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Business Requirements, Workshops & Solution Definition**

* Lead and facilitate customer workshops to understand current-state claims, benefits, pre-authorisation and operational processes, and translate them into clear future-state requirements.
* Capture and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, decision logs, assumptions and sign-off records.
* Prepare or contribute to implementation artefacts such as functional specifications, requirements frameworks, mapping workbooks, implementation plans and customer-facing summaries.
* Challenge unclear or incomplete requirements, separate confirmed scope from open questions, and drive closure with the relevant business and product stakeholders.

**2) Claims, Benefits and Business Rules Analysis**

* Analyse claims-calculation scenarios, benefit-triggering logic, exclusions, limits, tariffs, professional fees, utilisation and pre-authorisation requirements.
* Work with customer subject-matter experts to document formulas, decision rules, exceptions and expected outcomes in a form that product, engineering and QA teams can implement and test.
* Assess whether requirements can be met through standard product capability, configuration, an operational workaround or a product enhancement, and clearly document the recommended path and dependencies.
* Partner with configuration specialists and clinical SMEs to ensure requirements are sufficiently clear for benefit, rule, tariff and clinical-set configuration.

**3) Integration and Data Requirements**

* Coordinate business and functional analysis for API and data integration, including REST/JSON and HL7/FHIR-based claim request and response structures.
* Clarify field definitions, ownership, source-system availability, validation rules and mapping assumptions with customer and internal integration teams.
* Prepare sample payloads, field lists and mapping documentation, and coordinate internal review before customer submission and sign-off.
* Track integration dependencies and product gaps, and support defect analysis and retesting with engineering and QA teams.

**4) Delivery Tracking, Scope and Dependency Management**

* Maintain implementation trackers covering deliverables, decisions, actions, dependencies, risks, blockers, target dates and sign-off status.
* Create and maintain Jira epics and stories for implementation items, ensuring that requirements, acceptance criteria, ownership and dependencies are clearly recorded.
* Monitor customer and internal dependencies, highlight missed inputs or decisions early, and provide concise status updates and escalation points to the Implementation Lead.
* Support implementation planning by sequencing activities, identifying prerequisites and coordinating work across product, engineering, QA, clinical, configuration and customer teams.
* Apply disciplined scope and change control by identifying new or changed requirements, assessing delivery impact and ensuring agreement before implementation.

**5) Testing, Readiness and Go-Live Support**

* Define business acceptance criteria and expected results for functional, SIT and UAT scenarios, with particular focus on end-to-end claims outcomes.
* Support QA and customer testers by clarifying requirements, reproducing functional issues, distinguishing defects from requirement gaps, and coordinating resolution and retesting.
* Validate that agreed requirements, configurations, integrations and operational dependencies are ready for release and customer sign-off.
* Support cutover, go-live and post-release triage by preparing readiness inputs, tracking open items and coordinating business validation.

**6) Customer Enablement and Stakeholder Communication**

* Act as a day-to-day functional point of contact for assigned implementation workstreams and communicate clearly with customer business and technology stakeholders.
* Prepare structured meeting agendas, minutes, decision summaries, action lists and follow-up communications that make ownership and next steps explicit.
* Deliver product and process enablement sessions covering claims concepts, benefit and rule configuration, clinical/reference data and implementation ways of working.
* Build effective working relationships across countries and time zones, while maintaining clear accountability between Amplify Health and customer teams.

**7) Continuous Improvement and Reuse**

* Capture lessons learned and convert implementation experience into reusable templates, frameworks, checklists, sample artefacts and delivery standards.
* Identify recurring product or process gaps and provide evidence-based recommendations to improve implementation efficiency, customer readiness and product usability.
* Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new implementation team members and business analysts.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of business analysis or customer implementation experience, preferably within health insurance, healthcare technology, insurance platforms or another regulated industry.
* Practical experience leading requirements workshops and producing user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional specifications, mapping documents and implementation trackers.
* Strong understanding of health-insurance claims and benefit concepts, including claim adjudication, exclusions, limits, utilisation, tariffs, professional fees and pre-authorisation.
* Experience working across customer, product, engineering, integration, QA, clinical and operations teams to resolve requirements and delivery dependencies.
* Working knowledge of REST/JSON APIs and data mapping; familiarity with HL7/FHIR claim structures is an advantage.
* Experience with Jira and Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, defect triage and change control.
* Experience facilitating customer training, requirements playback and sign-off discussions.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to facilitate regional customer discussions and produce concise, decision-oriented documentation.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently while reporting to a regional lead.
* Clinical coding knowledge, including ICD, CPT, diagnosis, procedure or pharmacy coding concepts, is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively from India with stakeholders and a reporting line based in Singapore; occasional regional travel may be required.

**What You Will Gain in This Role**

* Direct ownership of business-analysis deliverables across complex customer implementations, from discovery through go-live.
* Exposure to regional healthcare claims transformation, including benefits, rules, tariffs, clinical coding, APIs and FHIR-based integrations.
* Opportunity to shape reusable implementation methods and work closely with senior product, engineering, clinical, QA and customer stakeholders across Asia.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:

You will own the end-to-end configuration strategy and execution, ensuring the system is designed, built, and deployed in alignment with the global operating model.

This is a hands-on role requiring deep SAP Fieldglass expertise. You will act as the internal design authority, partner closely with implementation partner, Product analyst and cross functional teams to ensure technical rigor across configuration build, testing, and deployment phases.

You will balance strategic oversight with detailed configuration execution to ensure scalability, compliance, and long-term sustainability of the solution. Also, you will act as the Fieldglass reporting expert within our team and ensure reporting standards and knowledge are maintained to a high degree while also delivering ongoing reporting support to our end users

Among your responsibilities, you will:

* Lead global configuration design for SAP Fieldglass, including:
* Workflows and approval chains
* Business rules and compliance controls
* Rate structures and complex pricing models
* SOW and milestone billing configurations
* Security model and role-based access design
* Establish configuration standards and governance processes
* Serve as primary technical counterpart to system integrators and external partners
* Validate and challenge solution designs to ensure scalability and alignment with business objectives
* Oversee integration design and validation with Workday, SAP S4HANA, Coupa, and other systems
* Lead configuration build reviews and technical quality assurance
* Manage quarterly SAP Fieldglass release assessments and regression strategy during implementation
* Identify risks related to data, compliance, and architecture
* Provide thought leadership on platform optimization and long-term roadmap

What You'll Bring

* 7-10+ years of SaaS or enterprise system configuration experience
* 4+ years deep SAP Fieldglass configuration expertise (required)
* Experience leading configuration workstreams in at least one global SAP Fieldglass implementation (required)
* Strong understanding of contingent workforce and services procurement processes
* Experience working with system implementation partner and global vendors
* Strong knowledge of integrations (Workday, SAP, Coupa, middleware)
* Experience managing release governance and change control processes
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues

Preferred:

* Experience in consulting or professional services environments
* Experience in multi-country deployments
* Knowledge of compliance and audit considerations (e.g., data privacy, worker classification controls)

As Manager – SaaS Engineering for SAP Fieldglass, you will work with:

* Other members of the squad, including Product Owner, analysts, testers and scrum master
* Global stakeholders including HR, Finance and business owners
* System implementation partner, MSP and global vendors
* IT integrations and delivery teams supporting broader applications

* Have a deep technical understanding of the SAP Fieldglass system functionality and apply that knowledge to support global implementation

description:
About the job Project Manager/ Senior Project Manager - School Governance
  
  
**Organisation:**

**Location:**
Gandhinagar, Gujarat (travel within the state and periodic travel to Delhi)
  
  
**About Central Square Foundation**
Central Square Foundation is a nonprofit organisation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. Since 2012, we have been partnering with the government and ecosystem stakeholders to improve the learning outcomes of children, especially from low-income communities. We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable, and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised 4 critical areas of work:
  
  

* Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN)
* EdTech
* Early Childhood Education (ECE)
* School Governance

*Learn more about CSF on our*
*website*
*.*
**About The Team**
The
**School Governance**
team at Central Square Foundation envisions a transformed school education delivery system that is principally accountable and transparent about its learning outcomes. It targets measuring and publicising the achievement of quality outcomes in public and private schools and establishing a State Schools Standards Authority to enable this reform.
  
  
**The Problem**
Despite extensive efforts to increase access to education, learning outcomes have remained alarmingly stagnant in the current educational landscape. Major government initiatives have focused on expanding access and providing input to schools, but their impact on improving educational outcomes has been tenuous, at best. An absence of outcomes-oriented and evidence-based governance is aggravated by a regulatory system where the government runs its own schools and regulates all schools, posing a conflict of interest due to the operator being the regulator. Further, there is no way to reliably measure the learning attainment of schools, making it difficult to hold them accountable for results.
  
  
**The Solution**
CSF's Schools Governance team acknowledges the pressing need for a systemic reform in education, which can be solved with a two-fold approach. The states need to: -
  
  

* Establish a robust and reliable learning outcome indicator at the school level by assessing student competencies through a competency-based census assessment (CCA). This will involve public disclosure of school data, while keeping the student data anonymous, to transparently show every school's quality and nudge them to make the necessary improvements.
* Create an independent school regulator, the State School Standards Authority (SSSA), which will operate outside the current Department of School Education. This body will focus on setting school standards and demand accountability from all schools, government or private.

**About The Work In Gujarat**
CSF's School Governance team helps states move from input-based regulation to outcome-based regulation, in line with the National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020). In Gujarat this means three connected pieces of work: building a reliable, school-level learning indicator through a Competency-based Census Assessment (CCA); enabling public disclosure of school quality while keeping student data anonymous; and supporting the State School Standards Authority (SSSA) as a regulator. Gujarat already runs a school quality programme, Gunotsav, which this work seeks to strengthen and align to outcomes.
  
  
**Position Summary**
You will run CSF's day-to-day execution of this programme in Gujarat. You are the single point of accountability who keeps government partners, technology vendors, and the internal team moving together. You are stepping into a live programme with existing relationships, an in-progress portal build, and a current roadmap, so the first priority is to absorb context quickly and hold continuity, not to rebuild from scratch.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Programme execution
* Own the Gujarat workplan, timelines, and deliverables for the SSSA programme, covering the CCA, public disclosure, and the supporting portal systems.
* Keep the programme on track against milestones, surface risks early, and drive decisions to closure.
* Government and stakeholder management
* Be CSF's primary working contact for the state education department, GCERT (Gujarat Council of Educational Research and Training), the SSSA body, and data or hosting agencies.
* Build trust at both the official and field level, manage approvals and clearances, and turn CSF's recommendations into actions the government can adopt.
* Quality assurance and Gunotsav
* Develop a clear view of where Gunotsav helps and where it falls short against the outcome-based intent of NEP 2020, keeping students and parents as the test of value.
* Work with the state to improve how assessment is done, how results are disclosed, and how findings feed back into teaching and school improvement.
* Product, portal, and vendor coordination
* Translate ground realities into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the school quality and assessment portals.
* Manage technology vendors on scope, delivery, quality, and timelines, and steer the path to production readiness across security, performance, scale, data privacy, and hosting.
* Coordinate integrations where needed, for example with UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus).
* Monitoring and continuity
* Track adoption and usage, and share regular dashboards and honest progress updates with the state team and leadership.
* Keep clean documentation, decision logs, and a current handover record so the programme never depends on one person's memory.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**

* 4 to 7 years of experience delivering complex programmes or technology-enabled projects, ideally in government, public systems, or the social sector.
* A graduate or postgraduate degree in any discipline.
* A track record of managing external vendors on time and quality.
* Strong stakeholder management, structured problem-solving, and clear written communication.
* Comfort working with data and digital platforms, including requirements, quality assurance, and releases. You do not need to write code, but you must be able to hold vendors to account on it.
* Fluent in English. Working Gujarati is a strong advantage for the field and government interface.
* Willing to be based in Gandhinagar and travel within the state.
* Familiarity with the Indian school education landscape and state-level systems. (preferred)
* Exposure to GovTech or large public sector platforms, and to government hosting and compliance, for example NIC hosting, security audits, and data protection. (preferred)
* Experience taking a product or programme from pilot to stable operation at scale. (preferred)

**Other Details**

* Remuneration competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales, based on experience.
* Start date: Immediate.

title: Product Architect
description:
**Product Lead**

Experience: 3–5 years | Product Architecture + Hands-on Building + UX

**Role Mandate**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Lead who can take an existing process, workflow or domain model and turn it into a simple, useful and scalable digital product.

You will work from problem → product architecture → prototype → MVP → user validation → iteration.

This is a builder role. You should be able to define how the product works, rapidly prototype and build using modern AI-enabled tools, and create sufficiently strong user experiences to test the product with real users.

The role spans both B2B and B2C product thinking:

OIS, Organization Intelligence System: primarily a B2B product helping organizations and leaders sense organizational conditions, interpret evidence and make better interventions.

SIP, Skills Intelligence Product: translates existing skills, capability, learning and development processes into digital workflows that may serve organizations, managers and individual users.

The challenge is not inventing every process from scratch. It is understanding an existing process deeply enough to determine what should be preserved, what should be simplified, what should be automated, and what should be fundamentally redesigned as a product.

What You Will Do

Product Architecture

Understand existing business, organizational and user workflows and convert them into clear product architecture.

Define users, problems, journeys, product objects, workflows, rules, outputs and outcomes.

Translate complex domain concepts into simple product experiences without losing their underlying logic.

Define MVP scope and decide what to build, prototype, automate, keep manual or defer.

Write clear product requirements, user flows and acceptance criteria.

Balance B2B requirements such as configuration, governance and enterprise workflows with B2C expectations of simplicity, engagement and self-service.

Build

Take ideas from concept to working prototype and MVP.

Personally build prototypes and product workflows using modern development and AI-assisted tools.

Work with APIs, databases, structured data and AI/LLM capabilities.

Use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Replit or equivalent to shorten build-test cycles.

Integrate existing services and platforms rather than over-engineering everything internally.

Work with specialist engineers as the product and technical architecture mature.

Product Experience

Design user journeys, wireframes and interaction flows.

Create usable prototypes in Figma/FigJam or equivalent.

Simplify complex workflows for both enterprise and individual users.

Put prototypes directly in front of users and observe where they struggle.

Iterate based on actual behavior and evidence, not only stated preferences.

You do not need to be a specialist UI designer. You should, however, be capable of taking a product from an idea to an experience that is good enough to put in a user's hands.

AI Product Thinking

Identify where AI improves the workflow and where conventional software or human judgment works better.

Design AI capabilities that are grounded, explainable, reviewable and correctable.

Work with LLM APIs, structured outputs, retrieval/RAG and AI-assisted workflows.

Design around hallucination, uncertainty, privacy and inappropriate automation.

Build simple evaluation mechanisms to determine whether AI output is actually useful.

Customer & User Validation

Talk directly with enterprise customers and individual users.

Understand existing workflows before redesigning them.

Test concepts and prototypes before investing heavily in engineering.

Participate in early pilots and product launches.

Measure usability, adoption, repeat use and customer value.

Use evidence to decide whether to continue, change, simplify or stop.

What We Are Looking For

Experience

3–5 years in product, product engineering, startup product development or a closely related role.

You should have demonstrated experience in several of the following:

Taking a digital product or substantial feature from idea to release.

Converting an existing offline, service or business process into a digital product/workflow.

Building B2B and/or B2C product experiences.

Personally creating prototypes or working software.

Working directly with users or customers.

Defining an MVP and making difficult scope trade-offs.

Working with AI-enabled products or rapidly learning AI product development.

Experience in AI, SaaS, HRTech, LearningTech, EdTech, skills, workforce, organization, knowledge or workflow products is useful but not mandatory.

\*\*Core Skills\*\*

Must Have

Strong product and systems thinking

Product architecture and workflow design

MVP definition and prioritization

User journey and interaction design

Working knowledge of Figma or equivalent

Comfort with APIs, databases and modern web applications

Hands-on use of AI coding/building tools

Understanding of LLM-based product capabilities

Strong written and verbal communication

Ability to work directly with founders, users and engineers

High comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration

Good to Have

Full-stack development experience

SQL and data modelling

React/TypeScript, Python or equivalent

LLM APIs, RAG and structured outputs

B2B SaaS/enterprise workflows

Consumer/self-service product experience

Product analytics and experimentation

What This Role Is Not

\*\*This is not a:\*\*

Project Manager managing timelines

Product Owner managing Jira

Business Analyst writing requirements

Pure UI/UX Designer

Pure Software Engineer

Prompt Engineer

Product Manager who hands specifications to engineering

We need someone who can understand the problem, structure the product, build enough of it to make it real, and learn directly from users.

How We Will Assess You

We will primarily look for evidence that you can:

Deconstruct an existing process and redesign it as a product.

Convert ambiguity into clear product objects, workflows and decisions.

Define a small, testable MVP rather than a large feature list.

Build or prototype enough of the product yourself to test the idea.

Design a simple experience for either an enterprise or individual user.

Use AI appropriately rather than adding AI simply because it is available.

Explain something you built, what you personally owned, what failed, and what you changed.

The Person We Want

A product thinker who builds. A builder who understands users. Someone who can take an existing process or complex idea, find its essential logic, turn it into a simple product, put it in users' hands and keep improving it from evidence.

Experience matters less than evidence of ownership, product judgment, building ability and learning velocity.

title: Product Engineering Intern
description:
About the job

**About firstbriq**

firstbriq is building an AI-powered platform that fixes how Indians plan, price, and execute home interiors — an industry defined by chaos, opacity, and cost overruns. We serve homeowners with planning and estimation tools and vendors with SaaS to run their business. Small team, high AI leverage, shipping fast.

**About the role**

We're not hiring you to write code from someone else's designs. We're hiring you to help build a product end-to-end. You’re expected to think through a feature, sketch how it should work, design the interface, write the code, ship it, test it, and improve it.

You'll work directly with the founder on real product decisions. You'll use modern AI tools
*(Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, v0, Figma AI, just to name a few)*
across every stage of your work and compress the distance from idea to working feature aggressively.

You don't need to be an expert at UX or engineering. You need enough fundamentals across both, real curiosity, and the ability to figure things out.

This isn't a role for someone who only wants to code from predefined tickets or designs. It's also not a pure design role. We're looking for someone who wants to get their hands dirty across the entire product-building process.

**What you'll actually do**

**Product & UX**

* Translate product requirements into user flows and basic wireframes
* Think through user journeys before writing code
* Propose UI solutions in Figma and iterate with the founder
* Spot usability issues in existing features and suggest fixes

**UI design & implementation**

* Convert wireframes into polished, responsive interfaces
* Apply firstbriq's brand guidelines consistently
* Build reusable components using shadcn/ui or similar libraries

**Web development**

* Build and ship frontend features in React / Next.js
* Integrate REST APIs and handle loading, error, and empty states
* Build dashboards and internal tools
* Deploy and maintain features in a production environment
* Ensure responsive behaviour across desktop, tablet, and mobile

**Code quality & cleanup**

* Work with firstbriq's existing production codebase, which is a meaningful part of the role
* Refactor redundant or inconsistent code, improve component reusability
* Maintain consistent structure and documentation
* Fix bugs and improve reliability
* AI-assisted development (a layer across everything above): AI tools will be used across product exploration, UX, UI, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation, and not as a separate stage.
* Use AI coding tools as part of daily workflow, not as a novelty
* Understand, review, and test AI-generated code rather than blindly accepting it
* Use AI to understand unfamiliar parts of the codebase
* Prototype UI and features using AI-assisted design tools
* Experiment with Agentic AI workflows where useful

You don't need AI expertise on day one, but you need the willingness to work AI-in-the-loop by default. We want an AI-assisted developer, not an AI-dependent one.

**Testing & iteration**

* Test across devices and browsers
* Debug functional and responsive issues
* Validate new work doesn't break existing features
* Incorporate user feedback into iterations

**Requirements**

**Must have**

* Basic working knowledge of React, or willingness and ability to become productive in React quickly
* HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub
* Understanding of responsive design and REST APIs
* Basic UI/UX sense; can create wireframes and think about user flows
* Ability to read and modify existing code, not just write new code
* Strong problem-solving and self-learning ability

**Good to have**

* Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
* shadcn/ui or similar component libraries
* Figma proficiency
* Basic understanding of backend services, databases, or server-side development
* Experience with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, v0)
* Personal projects or GitHub portfolio
* Deployed something on Vercel/Netlify/AWS
* Interest in home interiors, real estate, or the Indian consumer market

**What you'll learn**

* Turning an idea into a shipped feature
* Working with a real production codebase, not tutorials
* Refactoring and improving an existing production codebase
* React, Next.js, and modern frontend patterns
* API integration and full-stack thinking
* Deploying and maintaining features in production
* Using AI tools to move 3–5x faster than traditional development
* How product, design, and engineering decisions come together
* What building a startup from zero actually looks like

**First 2 weeks / 30 days / 60 days**

We compress ramp-up aggressively. AI tools make understanding a codebase far faster than it used to be — we expect you to use them.

Week 1–2: Get set up, understand the codebase with AI assistance, and ship your first small fix or component. Get comfortable with our workflow.

* Day 30: Take ownership of a feature end-to-end (wireframe to production) with guidance where required.
* Day 60: Ship features with increasing independence, contribute to product decisions, and drive code quality improvements.
* Beyond: Propose new ideas, own larger surfaces, and grow into a founding-team role if things click.

**Logistics**

Duration: Minimum 3 months, extendable to 6 months for strong performers

* Mode: Hybrid (Bengaluru preferred; remote considered for exceptional candidates)
* Time commitment: Full-time preferred, minimum 30 hrs/week
* Reports to: Founder directly
* Conversion: Strong performers will be offered full-time roles as firstbriq scales

**How to apply**

* **Send us:**
  GitHub profile or portfolio link
* One thing you've built (personal project, hackathon, freelance — anything counts)
* Any AI tools you've used and what you built with them

**Selection process: Portfolio review → 30-min call → small take-home task → founder interview**

**Apply to: talent@firstbriq.com**

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of programme management, design operations, stakeholder coordination, and organisational change.
  
  
You will serve as the operational backbone of the UX organisation by coordinating programmes, managing planning and budgets, facilitating governance, driving delivery alignment, supporting Design System adoption, and establishing scalable ways of working that allow UX teams to operate efficiently and effectively.
  
  
Working closely with UX leadership, UX Designers, UX Researchers, Design System teams, Product Managers, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will help build a world-class UX capability that delivers measurable value across Alstom's global digital landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**UX Program & Portfolio Management**

* Coordinate UX initiatives across multiple projects, product teams, business units, and transformation programmes.
* Build and maintain UX roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, and programme schedules.
* Facilitate portfolio planning and prioritisation activities in alignment with business objectives and product strategies.
* Manage programme risks, blockers, dependencies, budgets, and resource allocation.
* Track progress and ensure transparency across all UX initiatives.
* Organise and facilitate governance reviews, steering meetings, planning sessions, and cross-functional workshops.
* Drive alignment between UX, Product Management, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Business stakeholders.

**UX Operations & Ways of Working**

* Establish and maintain scalable UX operating processes and governance frameworks.
* Create repeatable processes that improve planning, coordination, delivery visibility, and team effectiveness.
* Define and maintain UX documentation frameworks, repositories, templates, standards, and playbooks.
* Support capacity planning, resource forecasting, onboarding, operational reporting, and budget management.
* Improve collaboration across distributed UX teams and business domains.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across the UX organisation.
* Support UX maturity growth through process optimisation and operational enablement.

**Design System Governance & Coordination**

* Partner closely with Design System Leads, UX Designers, UI Designers, and Front-end Engineering teams.
* Coordinate Design System planning, roadmap execution, release management, and adoption activities.
* Support governance processes ensuring consistency and scalability across products.
* Facilitate collaboration between product teams and Design System contributors.
* Track Design System adoption, implementation progress, and business impact.
* Ensure alignment between Design System evolution and product development priorities.
* Support the establishment of standards, patterns, reusable assets, and design governance practices.
